doc.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022

title: Name that Chick Corea tune
summary: Rowe scats 'One Step' and they praise the record's opening cut.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I’ve loved this conversation and I’m going to wrap up with name this Chick Corea tune.
And you’ll have to excuse my delivery.
Yay you got it. This is one of my favorite Chick Corea records.
That’s a beautiful record. Yeah. I know.
And I don’t know who made the decision but I thought it was a spot-on to put that as the first cut, side one.
I agree. Yeah I love that. And the “Friends” cut is a favorite of mine too, that piece as well. So there’s a lot of good stuff on it. Anyway good. You sing great!
I’m going to put that on my resume that you said that.
